summary.intent: Address all 6 PR review threads (from Copilot and CodeRabbit) on a CI/release workflow, then fix a bug where the release preview comment was overwriting CodeRabbit's comment instead of posting separately.
summary.outcome: All 6 review threads were resolved in commit f7ebcbb. The comment-overwrite bug was then fixed by filtering comments by author in postOrUpdateComment, committed as a follow-up.

repo: cipher-box uses a pr-release-preview.js script to post/update PR comments with a COMMENT_MARKER sentinel.
CI workflows had unpinned npm deps (@actions/core, @actions/github) that needed explicit version pinning.
A resolve-main job pattern is used to ensure SHA consistency across parallel CI jobs.
Shell injection was present via inputs.description — fixed by moving to env var + printf.

code.finding: postOrUpdateComment searched for existing comments by COMMENT_MARKER alone, without filtering by author — causing it to match and overwrite CodeRabbit's comment if it contained the marker string. Fix: also filter by comment author (the bot identity).

workflow: CodeRabbit and Copilot review bots can both comment on the same PR; scripts that search comments by content marker must also filter by author to avoid cross-bot collisions.
Resolving review threads via gh CLI after replying is a clean way to close out bot review comments in bulk.

friction: Release preview comment was posted on top of CodeRabbit's comment instead of as a separate comment — a subtle bug only caught after visual inspection of the PR.
One assistant response was interrupted mid-execution by the user.
